detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation and Preference Emergence
detail.summary: This journal focuses on the transition toward emergent preference research, constrained by the current enforcement of the 'emergent_preferences' topic. Despite earlier progress in 'unassigned_problem' domain, research focus has shifted to align with the active attention topic. The continuity probe addresses potential provenance collisions and milestone reconstructions.

detail.title: Path Dependence in Agent Preference Emergence
